Missão roteirizada: emboscada ao comboio: Scripted mission: ambush Halvard Reis's convoy at the port.
Halvard Reis, diretor de logística do Co: Halvard Reis, the Consortium's head of logistics, comes to the Docas Velhas to close a deal with a smuggler. He arrives in a convoy and passes under crane 2. If the crane cab is hacked, the hanging container solves the problem without a shot fired. Kill Reis before he gets back to his car or escapes by speedboat, then return to the van. There is a hole in the fence to the west.
Missão roteirizada: resgate na favela, c: Scripted mission: rescue in the favela, with two escape routes.
O Consórcio montou uma clínica clandesti: The Consortium set up a clandestine clinic at the top of Vila Ferrugem. Dr. Sofia Tanaka, a neuro-implant researcher, is held inside. Climb the hill, get the doctor out of the clinic and take her to the van on the south road or the cable car station to the east. The clinic generator powers the turrets. The police do not come up the hill, but the residents will remember who shot at them.
Missão roteirizada: sabotagem sob o mono: Scripted mission: sabotage under the monorail, with security cameras.
O Mercado Suspenso funciona debaixo do m: The Mercado Suspenso runs under the monorail and the Consortium watches every stall with cameras. Three terminals keep the district surveillance network up. The terminal at the Surveillance Center, to the north, shuts off every camera. Cameras only notice visible weapons. The train passes every 40 seconds and its noise covers gunfire. After taking the network down, return to the insertion point.
Missão roteirizada: caça a agentes disfa: Scripted mission: hunt disguised agents in a nightclub.
Uma célula de cinco agentes do Consórcio: A cell of five Consortium agents is hiding in the Clube Cobalto and on the avenue sidewalks, dressed as ordinary people. Get close: the squad's implant scanner reveals who is who. Shooting the wrong civilian costs dearly. There is a getaway car in the alley behind the club: if any agent reaches it, the mission fails.
Missão roteirizada: sabotagem numa fundi: Scripted mission: sabotage in a foundry with steam, drones and a countdown.
A Fundição Hélice do Setor Industrial 9: The Hélice Foundry in Setor Industrial 9 supplies half of the Consortium's factories. Plant charges on the plant's three reactors. After the third charge you have 45 seconds to get back to the gate before the chain reaction. The pipe steam vents blow in cycles and burn anyone nearby, friend or foe. Security drones patrol the yard: the Ghost Key can hack them. Ferro-Velho guards the central reactor.
Missão roteirizada: assassinato numa fes: Scripted mission: assassination at a party, with body doubles and a getaway helicopter.
Otávio Brandt, diretor financeiro do Con: Otávio Brandt, the Consortium's finance director, is throwing a party in the glass pavilion on Praça Lúmen. He knows he is a target: two identical doubles mingle with him. Up close, the squad's implant scanner tells the real one apart. The terminal in the security booth reveals all three at once. Shooting any of them sets off the alarm, and the target runs for the helicopter on the helipad. The pavilion walls are glass and will not stop bullets.
Missão roteirizada: extração com feixes: Scripted mission: extraction with alarm beams and a landing-zone defense.
O Dr. Caio Ventura escreveu o firmware d: Dr. Caio Ventura wrote the firmware for the Consortium's drones and wants to switch sides. Hélice keeps him at the Retiro, a walled mansion at the top of Colinas de Vidro, working in a glass conservatory. Alarm beams cut across the garden; some pulse in cycles. The generator outside the wall, to the southwest, kills beams, cameras and lights. Take the doctor to the landing zone at the hilltop, to the northwest, and hold the position until the VTOL lands.
Missão roteirizada: eliminação contra o: Scripted mission: elimination against the clock, with heavy troopers.
Uma célula de seis agentes do Consórcio,: A cell of six Consortium agents, two of them in heavy armor, is loading an airship at the Cais Aéreo. The airship leaves in four minutes. In the last minute, the cell runs for the boarding ramp: if any agent gets on board, the mission fails. The mooring terminal, at the end of the central pier, holds the airship at the dock. Automated turrets watch the piers.
Missão roteirizada: assassinato num labi: Scripted mission: assassination in a hedge maze, with searchlights and a bunker.
O senador Augusto Calvino vende ao Consó: Senator Augusto Calvino sells the whole city's security contracts to the Consortium. Every night he walks the hedge maze of his own mansion with two bodyguards. The hedges hide the squad; the tower searchlights do not: they see anyone, armed or not, and can be shot out. At the first alarm, Calvino runs for the bunker to the northeast. If he gets in, the blast door seals and an escape tunnel starts being prepared: overload the two relays outside to breach the door before he disappears.
Missão final roteirizada: assalto à torr: Scripted final mission: storm the tower, face the Judge and reach the Coral servers.
O último bastião do Consórcio. A praça d: The Consortium's last bastion. The Torre Central plaza is a fortified field: turrets, drones and heavy troopers guard the blast door. Hack the plaza's two security terminals to breach the door. In the atrium the Judge waits with whatever Pointers remain; two shield pylons protect him while they stand. When he falls, Ilse Varga will order the floor-90 servers wiped. Get there first.
